brief:
Israeli forces raided several shops in Hebron and beat Palestinians during operations in the nearby town of Halhul in the occupied West Bank on Sunday evening, the Wafa news agency reported. The raids targeted commercial establishments in Hebron while separate incidents of violence occurred in Halhul during the same period.

No additional details on the extent of damage, number of those injured, or stated purpose of the operations were immediately available.
dek: Israeli forces raid Hebron shops, assault Palestinians amid siege Israeli forces raided several shops in Hebron amid the siege of the city and beat Palestinians during a raid on nearby Halhul on Sunday evening, Wafa news agency reported.
title: Israeli forces raid Hebron shops, beat Palestinians in Halhul
